notes: Snapshot year is the fiscal year ended 31 March 2024 (data.js fy 'Mar 2024'), so this uses the Biocon Integrated Annual Report FY 2024 and the shareholding pattern as at 31 March 2024, not later reports. Consolidated statements are in Indian Rupees millions (÷ 1,000 = billions). OWNERSHIP: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw's 40.36% is her direct holding as stated in the annual report (the Reg 31 shareholding pattern gives the same 48,45,81,970 shares and 40.36%). Glentec International holds a further 19.76%; the shareholding pattern names her as Glentec's significant beneficial owner, so Glentec is recorded in `family` as her vehicle rather than as an independent holder. The two figures are separate holdings and are not summed here. The disclosed promoter total is 60.64% (annual report, Corporate Governance Report, category-wise distribution as on March 31, 2024: 'Promoters (Indian & Foreign) 728,024,176 60.64'; PDF p. 230, printed p. 228); it is not used as `family` because it already contains her own 40.36%. It also includes Ravi Mazumdar's 0.44% and Dev Mazumdar's 0.08%. Shareholding-pattern percentages are of all 1,20,06,00,000 shares (there are no depository receipts; 0.32% is held by the employee welfare trust). LARGEST HOLDERS: only non-promoter holders above 1% named in the shareholding pattern are listed. The LIC line is named after the scheme as the filing prints it (insurance companies hold 5.01% in total). Quant Momentum Fund (1.24%) is the next-largest named holder. FPIs hold 5.63% in aggregate, but none is named. DIVIDENDS: ₹1,801 million paid to owners of the company, taken from the consolidated statement of changes in equity. The consolidated cash-flow line (₹2,030 million) includes dividends to non-controlling interests (₹226 million in the SOCE). BUYBACKS: no repurchase in FY24; the only purchase line, of treasury shares for the ESOP trust (₹647 million, FY23), would be excluded anyway. STOCK COMP: the consolidated cash-flow add-back, which includes Syngene and Biocon Biologics plans. The segment name 'European union (incuding Ireland)' is printed with that typo in the report and is shown corrected.

footprint.notes: Snapshot FY2024 (year ended Mar 31, 2024). The BRSR is the SEBI-mandated Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report, released by Biocon as a Supplementary Data Book with the Integrated Annual Report FY2024 (tier filing); its boundary is Biocon Limited plus Biocon Biologics (India and Malaysia) and excludes Syngene. It gives only national vs international counts, so international plants/offices are a region row (the plants are named as Malaysia and New Jersey, offices are not). The BRSR says Biocon serves 120+ countries but gives no per-country counts; its workforce table is by nationality, not location, so it is not used. No employees or taxes by country found. Sites come from the Integrated Annual Report's own descriptions; Syngene's sites (Bengaluru, Mangaluru, Hyderabad) are not listed.
